description: A single-panel three-dimensional surface diagram (a composition vs deformation-mechanism map; not a micrograph or spectrum). It plots C content (wt.%) on the vertical axis (0–1.2) against Mn content (wt.%, 0–35) and Al content (wt.%, 0–12) on the two horizontal axes; the mesh surface is shaded with a colour bar on the right scaled 0–1.2, matching the C-axis range. Printed region labels divide the surface into deformation-mechanism fields: "TRIP" (low-Al, outer right edge), "TWIP" (higher Al), "TWIP+Kappa" (bottom edge), "MBIP" (top right, highest C), "MBIP + Kappa" (top left) and the "Kappa-carbide forming border", labelled along an internal boundary. Two labelled iso-SFE contours are drawn across the surface, "Iso-SFE 50 mJ/m²" and "Iso-SFE 20 mJ/m²". The figure makes one argument: in Fe–Mn–Al–C steel, raising Al (with C and Mn) moves the composition across the κ-carbide border and across increasing iso-SFE lines, so the operative deformation mechanism shifts from TRIP to TWIP and finally to MBIP. No numeric grid values or data points are printed on the surface itself.

observations.observation: The figure is a three-dimensional surface plot whose axes are printed as 'C content (wt.%)' (vertical, tick range 0–1.2), 'Mn content (wt.%)' (0–35) and 'Al content (wt.%)' (0–12).
A colour bar on the right-hand side of the plot is scaled from 0 to 1.2, i.e. the same range as the vertical C-content axis.
The surface carries printed deformation-mechanism region labels: 'TRIP', 'TWIP', 'TWIP+Kappa', 'MBIP' and 'MBIP + Kappa'.
A boundary line labelled 'Kappa-carbide forming border' is written across the surface, separating the κ-carbide-bearing fields from the others.
Two iso-SFE contours are drawn on the surface and labelled 'Iso-SFE 50 mJ/m²' and 'Iso-SFE 20 mJ/m²'.

'TRIP' occupies the low-Al outer edge of the surface, 'TWIP' the next field inward, 'TWIP+Kappa' the bottom edge, and 'MBIP'/'MBIP + Kappa' the high-Al, high-C region, so increasing Al content shifts the mechanism label from TRIP toward MBIP.
The figure is stated to show the relationship between composition, deformation mechanism and SFE in Fe–Mn–Al–C steel at room temperature.
The citing text states that the SFE values of these steels increase with increased Al content.

The citing text states that the deformation mechanism changes from TRIP to TWIP and then to MBIP and SIP, accompanied by κ-carbide precipitation, and that the figure can be used to predict the deformation mechanism of single austenite-base Fe–Mn–Al–C steels.
The citing text attributes the Al-content effect on tensile properties of single ferrite-base Fe–Mn–Al–C steels to crystal-structure changes and refers to this figure.
The label 'SIP' named in the citing text as one of the deformation mechanisms is not visible as a printed region label on this figure.

subfigures.description: 3D composition–mechanism surface map: C content (wt.%) 0–1.2 on the vertical axis vs Mn content (wt.%) 0–35 and Al content (wt.%) 0–12 on the horizontal axes, with a 0–1.2 colour bar on the right. Region labels TRIP, TWIP, TWIP+Kappa, MBIP and MBIP+Kappa are printed on the surface, together with a 'Kappa-carbide forming border' line and two iso-SFE contours labelled 'Iso-SFE 50 mJ/m²' and 'Iso-SFE 20 mJ/m²'.

unreadable_items: No numerical values are printed on the surface itself, so the exact composition boundaries between the TRIP / TWIP / MBIP and κ-carbide fields cannot be read; only qualitative region labels are available.
Fine mesh/wireframe detail of the 3D surface is at low resolution and individual grid lines cannot be counted.
The label 'SIP', reported in the citing text as a mechanism field, could not be located on the figure.
